name: ace-knowledge
description: Client document ingestion: turns an engineering archive into a structured, verifiable knowledge store. Enforces a tenancy boundary so one client's material cannot reach another's engagement.

engagement_root.title: Engagement root
engagement_root.description: Absolute path to THIS engagement's directory. Client material is read and written only beneath it; the tenancy hook denies file access outside it. Required — the boundary cannot be enforced without knowing where it is.

client_id.title: Client identifier
client_id.description: Short identifier for the client this engagement belongs to. Recorded in every ingested page's provenance and used to detect cross-engagement contamination.
